source_snapshot.procedure: Execute lsusb under the BMC console.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command completes without error and returns expected output.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; uses sshpass with disabled host-key verification and returns raw output but leaves expected inventory undefined.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE/LOW; requires verified BMC endpoint, protected authentication, exit status and structured expected-inventory comparison.

old_problem: Expected output was not defined, and the proposed sshpass/StrictHostKeyChecking=no transport exposes credentials and permits wrong-endpoint collection. Nonempty host-side output cannot establish the BMC USB inventory.
disposition_reason: The read-only command semantics are standard and safe. ED-03/15/20 allow BMC identity, supported usbutils/provider and the versioned VID:PID/product/multiplicity oracle to remain project configuration. Stable identities can be compared while dynamic bus/device numbers are normalized; no engineering decision is needed to invent an actual platform inventory.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2224, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2225 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00008-V002 / d1cdca01ca7e6f19 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Authenticate to the verified BMC console with trusted host-key checking and protected credentials; do not substitute the host OS USB namespace.
Record command/provider version and run unfiltered lsusb once, preserving stdout, stderr, exit status and timestamp.
Compare stable VID:PID, product and multiplicity against a versioned project inventory; normalize only documented dynamic bus/device addresses and approved optional population.
A zero exit proves command completion, not inventory correctness; missing, unexpected or duplicate devices remain explicit discrepancies.
Do not install packages, reset USB, bind/unbind, reload drivers or write sysfs during this case.
Stop on wrong endpoint, transport/auth failure, missing command, nonzero status or malformed output; no corrective mutation/retry.
No SSH login, command, package installation, USB action, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: BMC-console lsusb enumeration against approved inventory
test_case.purpose: Verify that the intended BMC console provides a functioning lsusb command and enumerates the project-approved BMC-side USB devices with correct stable identities and multiplicities.
required_package: Verified BMC endpoint, firmware/build and trusted secret-safe console access
Supported lsusb/usbutils provider or approved equivalent mapping
Versioned expected BMC-side VID:PID/product/multiplicity inventory with optionality and normalization rules
test_case.test_command: Through a trusted authenticated session to the verified BMC console, record lsusb provider/version, run unfiltered `lsusb` once, capture complete stdout/stderr/exit/timestamp, parse VID:PID/product/multiplicity and compare with the signed BMC-side inventory while normalizing only approved dynamic bus/device numbers.
test_case.expected_result: The command exits zero without transport/tool error and the parsed BMC-side inventory exactly matches all required identities and multiplicities, with only documented optional entries and address normalization.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires zero exit plus a complete structured match to the signed BMC inventory. Nonzero exit, malformed/truncated output, missing/unexpected/duplicate device, multiplicity mismatch or unapproved optionality is FAIL. Missing inventory or access blocks execution, not review resolution.
safety_gate: Verify the endpoint is the BMC console and enforce trusted host-key and secret-safe authentication.
Read-only enumeration only; no installation, reset, bind/unbind, driver reload or sysfs write.
Preserve complete raw output and stop without corrective action on any error.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, BMC/SUT firmware/build and authenticated endpoint
Parsed stable USB identities/multiplicities, signed expected matrix and discrepancy list
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected. On endpoint, transport, tool or parse failure, close the session, preserve evidence and leave USB/BMC state untouched; do not install or repair within this test.

source_conflict.reason: The source consistently requests BMC-console lsusb and expected output; the concrete inventory is a runtime oracle rather than a conflict.

blocked.reason: Standard read-only enumeration semantics are clear; inventory and endpoint bindings are project configuration.
